title: Ops Slate: taskified admin utilities and incident choreography
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Convert a set of ad-hoc admin scripts and documented remediation steps into a composable 'Ops Slate'—a set of taskified admin utilities with typed inputs, idempotency guarantees, telemetry hooks, and safe execution guards. The Slate will power incident choreography (guided multi-step fixes), support automation playflows, and a lightweight CLI/console surface for on-call engineers. Success metrics: mean time to repair (MTTR) of common incidents down by 30% in 60 days; 80% of scripted remediations executed via Ops Slate in first 2 months; zero unsafe escalations during canary runs.
scope: MVP includes: 1) task runner API for composing steps with pre/post checks, 2) library of 12 curated admin primitives (drain node, rotate key, restart worker group, evict cache shard, rebuild KV fragment, query request traces), 3) UI surface in Console minimal runner, and 4) audit/telemetry integration (structured events + run metadata). Excluded: full RBAC redesign, long-running workflow persistence (post-MVP).
milestones: 2026-03-28: canary run with staging oncall team
risks: Privileged actions need hardened approval flow - mitigated via dry-run + approval gates
Task idempotency edgecases for partial failures - mitigated with checkpointing and compensating steps
Possible leak of secrets to logs - mitigated with secret-redaction middleware
rollout_plan: Start with internal staging canary (oncall+SRE), run a week of supervised incidents and simulated failures. Collect telemetry and safety incidents. Expand to production read-only mode for 2 weeks, then enable write actions behind approval + 2-person rule. Post-mortem after first 10 write executions.
testing_plan: Unit tests + integration harness that replays recorded incidents. Chaos scenarios run in staging: network partitions, partial API failures, and KV inconsistency. Include synthetic safety tests that validate rollback paths.
observability: Emit structured run events to logs and metrics: run.start, step.start, step.finish, step.fail, run.complete, run.compensate. Tag runs with operator, ticket_id, environment, and task-version. Dashboard query: success rate by task, MTTR delta, anomalous step durations.
security_notes: Design requires KMS integration for temporary access tokens. All privileged connectors must go through service-account proxy. Security review scheduled with InfoSec 2026-03-11. Secrets never logged and scrubbing middleware added to pipeline.
